description_en: Creates an asynchronous image tampering detection task and returns the task ID
description_zh: 用于创建异步图片篡改检测任务，返回任务ID
kebab_example: aliyun aideepsign create-image-detection-task --client-token 5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B3FF3898 --object-key deepsign/123456789/scan/abc12345.jpg --image-url https://example.com/id-card.jpg --detect-type tamper --use-tamper-small-model true --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateImageDetectionTask

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一。`ClientToken` 只支持 ASCII 字符，且不能超过 64 个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ObjectKey of the image to be detected in OSS. When using `ObjectKey`, ensure that the key belongs to the namespace of the current caller. You must specify either `ImageUrl` or `ObjectKey`
parameters.help_zh: 待检测图片在 OSS 中的 `ObjectKey`。使用 `ObjectKey` 时需确保该 Key 属于当前调用者的命名空间。`ImageUrl` 与 `ObjectKey` 二选一，至少提供一个
parameters.name: object_key

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image to be detected. Only HTTP and HTTPS protocols are supported. You must specify either `ImageUrl` or `ObjectKey`
parameters.help_zh: 待检测图片的 URL 地址，仅支持 HTTP/HTTPS 协议。`ImageUrl` 与 `ObjectKey` 二选一，至少提供一个
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en: [Deprecated] The detection type. All detection is unified through the tampering detection pipeline, and this parameter no longer affects the actual detection mode. The values tamper and aigc are still accepted for backward compatibility. Other values return InvalidParam. We recommend that you do not pass this parameter
parameters.help_zh: （已废弃） 检测类型。所有检测统一走篡改检测链路，此参数不再影响实际检测模式。仍接受 tamper/aigc（向后兼容），传入其他值返回 InvalidParam。建议不再传
parameters.name: detect_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the small model for tampering detection. This parameter takes effect only when the tampering detection pipeline is used (DetectType is not specified or is set to tamper). If this parameter is not specified, the large model is used by default.

`true`: Uses the small model for tampering detection. The large model report is not generated, and LlmResult is empty. However, basic algorithm results such as AIGC, AI post-processing, and PS localization are still returned.
`false`: Uses the large model for tampering detection. The comprehensive analysis report from the large model (LlmResult) is returned.
Not specified: The large model is used by default
parameters.help_zh:
篡改检测是否使用小模型。仅在走篡改检测链路时生效（DetectType 不传或 tamper）。不传时默认使用大模型。

`true`：篡改检测使用小模型，不产出大模型报告，LlmResult 为空，但仍返回 AIGC/AI 后处理/PS 定位等基础算法结果。
`false`：篡改检测使用大模型，返回大模型综合分析报告（LlmResult）。
不传：默认使用大模型
parameters.name: use_tamper_small_model
